subject: Implementing non-training lock for live chat logs — technical & contracting steps
messages:
From: Olga Ramos <olga.ramos@zenhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@zenhealth.com>, ZenHealth Legal <legal@zenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — ensure live chat transcripts are excluded from model training

Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our compliance team reviewed the flow and has a hard requirement for the pilot: any live chat transcripts and agent notes captured during the pilot must never be used for model improvement or training.

Specific asks:
- A contractual amendment/short addendum acknowledging non-training for the pilot data
- Operational guarantees (e.g., capture flag, immediate ephemeralization, or a separate non-learning ingestion path)
- Confirmation about prompt/response ownership and whether Redwood will claim any derivative rights over AI-generated summaries we store

We’d like to get this buttoned up before we turn on chat routing (planned week of Sep 13).

Olga
Head of Product, ZenHealth
[Attachment: compliance-checklist_zenhealth.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Ramos <olga.ramos@zenhealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — ensure live chat transcripts are excluded from model training

Hi Olga — really appreciate the clear asks. Looping in David (privacy/ops) and Kimberly (legal) so we can map the technical and contractual steps. Quick answers up front: yes — we can implement a non-training ingestion path and a capture flag at the routing layer. We can also provide a short addendum to the DPA that covers the pilot window and specifies no-model-improvement for captured interactions.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Legal: Kimberly to draft a one-page addendum that (a) commits to no use for model improvement for the pilot, (b) clarifies ownership of agent prompts and AI-generated summaries, and (c) defines retention for evidence exports.
2) Ops/Engineering: David to propose the implementation: a tagged ingestion route (livechat: non-train) + ephemeral KV retention for summaries, plus audit logs for exports.
3) Delivery: Camila to share the addendum with ZenHealth legal and confirm sign-off timeline.

Can we target a draft addendum by Sep 2 EOD? That will give us a week to review before the planned routing toggle.

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Signature]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Ramos <olga.ramos@zenhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — ensure live chat transcripts are excluded from model training

Camila / team — draft addendum attached. Key points we included (summary):
- Scope: Pilot period (Sep 13–Oct 13) and capture channels (live chat, agent notes).
- No-model-improvement: Redwood covenants not to use pilot-captured content to update models or model weights, directly or indirectly, during the pilot and for 12 months after ingestion.
- Operational controls: data must be routed via a non-training ingestion lane (flagged), stored in an isolated tenant with no access to training pipelines, and subject to deletion/export requests via the API.
- Ownership & derivatives: ZenHealth retains ownership of raw prompts and responses; Redwood is granted a limited license solely to provide the service. Any Redwood-generated summaries will be marked as derived artifacts; ZenHealth can opt-in/opt-out of Redwood retaining copies of those summaries.
- Evidence & audit: Redwood will provide an evidence pack on request (audit logs, storage tenancy, flow diagram).

Technical implementation notes (David):
- We propose a non-train flag at the ingestion gateway. Events with the flag will be written to a separate S3 bucket (tenant-scoped) and tagged in our audit index.
- Ephemeral summarization: summaries can be generated in ephemeral compute with an option to not persist KV cache.
- Export path: we can supply a signed export (SFTP/HTTPS) and a delivery manifest for compliance.

Attachments: non-train-addendum_v1.pdf, ops-implementation-checklist.xlsx

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: non-train-addendum_v1.pdf (PDF)]

From: Olga Ramos <olga.ramos@zenhealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@zenhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — ensure live chat transcripts are excluded from model training

Thanks — this is great and tracks with our compliance team's expectations. A few follow-ups from our side:
- Please add an explicit clause that Redwood will not use any derived summaries for benchmarking/model evaluation internally without explicit written consent.
- Can Priyom confirm that the proposed non-train flag is enforced end-to-end (ingest gateway -> storage -> routing rules) and whether there are any supporting telemetry fields we should capture on our side to prove messages were flagged?
- Timeline: ZenHealth legal can sign the addendum the week of Sep 6 if we get a final by Sep 3. If signed, we will schedule the chat routing toggle for Sep 14.

Olga
Head of Product, ZenHealth
